usd_reason: The dollar logged its worst week in over 3 months amid Fed doubts
gold_reason: U.S. Treasury yields fall as oil prices plunge on Iran de-escalation hopes
indices_reason: The market is waiting for more information before making a move
lead_story: The recent de-escalation in Iran has led to a decrease in oil prices, which in turn has caused U.S. Treasury yields to fall. This has created uncertainty in the market and is currently the biggest macro driver. The Federal Reserve is also under pressure to act on inflation, which is at its lowest in years.
